name: KromiumStorage
summary: Facade for Cookie and Storage Management. Provides methods for clearing cache, reading cookies, and mutating storage state.

methods.name: getCookiesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies available to the current page.

methods.name: getCookieAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific cookie by name.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.signature: fun setCookie(name: String, value: String, domain: String? = null, path: String = "/", isSecure: Boolean = false, isHttpOnly: Boolean = false, expires: Date? = null): Boolean
methods.description: Sets a cookie on the global cookie manager.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Expiration date, or null for session cookie.

methods.name: clearCookies
methods.description: Clears all cookies from the global manager.

methods.name: clearWebStorageAsync
methods.description: Clears Local Storage and Session Storage for the current origin.

methods.name: clearBrowsingDataAsync
methods.signature: fun clearBrowsingDataAsync(clearCookies: Boolean = true, clearStorage: Boolean = true): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
